title: Split functions/src/index.ts's five unrelated concerns into focused modules
rule: Fowler lens (misplaced responsibility / god-file); AG-3 intent

evidence.quote:
/**
 * Triggered when a Firebase Auth user is deleted.
// V2-R3 C3 — Tutor grant lifecycle Cloud Functions
// Tutor write-path Cloud Functions — S4 (Talmid-View Squad)

why: One 2029-line file houses account-deletion cascades, a scheduled audit-log purge, the bulk-completion proxy, the full invite/accept/decline/revoke/resign grant lifecycle, and 12 near-identical tutor CRUD write-paths. Every change -- including several fixes this audit recommends -- touches the same file, so unrelated concerns share one blast radius for code review, git blame, and merge conflicts.
recommendation: Split by concern (e.g. deletes.ts, tutor_invites.ts, tutor_writes.ts, triggers.ts) with index.ts re-exporting every `export const` so deployed function names and functions/test imports are unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: index.ts (or its replacement barrel) is under a stated line budget (e.g. <300 lines); `npm run build` still compiles; every existing export name is preserved.

corrections: Finding says '12 near-identical tutor CRUD write-paths' under the S4 header; direct count of exported consts from tutorResetCompletion through tutorEditProfile is 13. Off-by-one, immaterial to the verdict. Also note AG-3's line cap is textually scoped to 'hand-written Dart files' — citing it against a .ts file is an analogy, not a direct violation; the finding itself hedges this correctly with 'AG-3 intent.'
